text.aria-label: Preheat a wide heavy skillet until a drop of water evaporates immediately
text.tspan: Preheat a wide heavy skillet until a drop of water

text.tspan: Required by: toast spices; brown in batches; toast almonds

text.aria-label: Warm a heavy lidded pot for the sauce branch
text.tspan: Warm a heavy lidded pot for the sauce branch

text.aria-label: Rinse the rice until the water is clear, then soak before draining thoroughly
text.tspan: Rinse the rice until the water is clear, then soak before

text.aria-label: Warm a broad serving platter and eight shallow bowls
text.tspan: Warm a broad serving platter and eight shallow bowls

text.aria-label: sliced onion, garlic, and ginger mixture
80 g cilantro leaves and tender stems
text.tspan: 80 g cilantro leaves and tender stems

text.aria-label: layered spiced chicken and rice platter with herb sauce and toasted almonds
Uses: 2 tsp whole coriander seeds · 2 tsp whole cumin seeds
Uses: 1.6 kg boneless chicken thigh pieces · 18 g fine sea salt · 300 g thick plain yogurt
Uses: 8 garlic cloves · 50 g fresh ginger · 3 large yellow onions
Uses: 500 mL unsalted chicken stock · 800 g peeled plum tomatoes
Until the tomatoes have broken down and the sauce leaves a brief trail behind the spoon
Until the chicken is tender and the sauce clings to each piece
Until every grain is tender and separate with no water remaining at the bottom
Uses: 80 g cilantro leaves and tender stems · 3 limes
Until the sauce is vivid green and pourable while retaining tiny visible herb flecks
Until rice forms an even base, chicken remains distinct, herb sauce is distributed in ribbons, and almonds stay crisp on top
